    print(f'  step={step:>7d}  ve_ratio={ve:.4f}  NVE={nve:.2f}{flag}')
if data:

    peak_step, peak_ve = data[peak_idx]
    peak_nve = peak_ve / baseline
    final_step, final_ve = data[-1]
    final_nve = final_ve / baseline
    nve_above = [(s, v/baseline) for s, v in data if v/baseline >= 1.5]
    if nve_above:
        window_start = nve_above[0][0]
        window_end = nve_above[-1][0]
        window_len = window_end - window_start
        consecutive = True
        for i in range(1, len(nve_above)):
            if nve_above[i][0] - nve_above[i-1][0] > 15000:
                consecutive = False
                break
        sustained = 'sustained' if (window_len >= 35000 and consecutive) else 'transient'
    else:
        window_start = window_end = window_len = 0
        sustained = 'no_civo'

    print(f'  FINAL: step={final_step} ve_ratio={final_ve:.4f} NVE={final_nve:.2f}')
    print(f'  NVE>=1.5 window: {window_start}-{window_end} ({window_len} steps)')
    print(f'  CLASSIFICATION: {sustained}')
"
